items.title: Renew Columbia business license
items.description: Businesses in Columbia hold an annual business license, renewed online with the license number from the renewal postcard.

items.title: Renew Independence business license
items.authority: City of Independence Regulated Industries Division
items.description: Business licenses are effective for one year from the month issued and renewed each year; the fee scales with projected gross receipts.

items.title: Obtain and renew Kansas City business license
items.authority: City of Kansas City, Missouri Finance Department
items.description: New businesses register (Form RD-100) and file the business license (Form RD-105) within 60 days of opening, renewing by March 1 each year; the fee depends on prior-year gross receipts.

items.title: File Kansas City earnings and profits tax return (RD-108)
items.authority: City of Kansas City, Missouri Finance Department
items.description: Businesses pay the 1% tax on net profits (return due April 15, even in a loss year) while the earnings tax remains in effect.

items.title: Withhold and remit Kansas City earnings tax (RD-110)
items.authority: City of Kansas City, Missouri Finance Department
items.description: Employers withhold the 1% earnings tax for employees who live or work in the city and file the quarterly return.

note: City letters confirm an annual renewal but with license-specific penalty dates; no single date was found.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Lee's Summit
items.description: Review the cited local licensing source before operating; requirements may be activity-specific and can differ by business type or location.

note: Only a third-party listing (December 31) was found for the renewal; the city's own page was not confirmed.

items.description: Review the cited local licensing source before operating; requirements may be activity-specific and can differ by business type or location.

items.title: File St. Louis business earnings tax return
items.authority: City of St. Louis Collector of Revenue, Earnings Tax Department
items.description: Businesses located in or working in the City of St. Louis pay a 1% tax on business earnings; account application Form E-9; return due April 15 (calendar year).

items.title: File St. Louis payroll expense tax and earnings tax withholding (P-10/W-10)
items.authority: City of St. Louis Collector of Revenue, Earnings Tax Department
items.description: Employers pay the 0.5% payroll expense tax and withhold earnings tax for employees working in the city, filing quarterly.
